items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a normal integral algebraic space and a point of it there is a normal integral affine scheme with an etale morphism to the space having the point in its image (statement lines 516-521). The proof (proof lines 523-536) uses decency to make the number of irreducible components of an affine etale neighbourhood finite, decomposes the normal ring of that neighbourhood into a product of normal domains, and picks the component through which the point is reached. H2: a three-step argument with two inputs, written out in full.
